description: Use this when a user asks what the good deals are in Canada right now, or for Black Friday deals, optionally in a category or under a price. Returns Lowvyn's current verified deals: during a shopping event (Black Friday through Cyber Monday 2026) the event flyer, re-checked every 2 hours against each product's own price history; otherwise the weekly flyer, with prices re-confirmed. Each deal has the current price (CAD), what it is compared against (comparePrice, compareBasis), percent and dollars off, the Lowvyn Score and Deal Verdict, and the same id + canonicalUrl other tools accept. flyerUrl is the full flyer on lowvyn.com; watchUrl is where the user can get an email when the price drops.

category.description: Optional category or product type to filter by, e.g. 'TVs', 'headphones', 'coffee'

name: get_deals
title: Get current deals
